question:
Five employees of the same company, Jagruti, Krishna, Laxman, Maya and Nirupam, live on five different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it number 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5. Krishna and Nirupam live on the topmost and bottommost floors, respectively. Jagruti lives on the floor immediately above Laxman. Maya lives on the floor immediately above Nirupam.

Who lives on the second floor?
solution:
According to the given information:

1) Krishna and Nirupam live on the topmost and bottommost floors, respectively.
